scripts.import: node scripts/import-data.mjs && node scripts/import-wiki-enemies.mjs && node scripts/import-banners.mjs && node scripts/import-levelup.mjs && node scripts/add-beta-levelup.mjs && node scripts/import-weapon-sources.mjs && python scripts/import-weapon-art.py && node scripts/import-calendar.mjs
scripts.dev:full: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.deploy:verbose: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name genshinflex
scripts.feedback: wrangler d1 execute genshinflex-feedback --remote --command "SELECT id, created_at, kind, page, contact, substr(message,1,300) AS message FROM feedback ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 30"
scripts.guides: wrangler d1 execute genshinflex-feedback --remote --command "SELECT id, created_at, character, mode, author, contact, status, length(payload) AS size FROM guide_submissions ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 30"
